rawContent: Another movie on @netflix that is worth a watch and speaks to the #metoo movement in India and silencing within families of women who experiences sexual violence. So appropriate and timely!

My day ended with @robinfield’s insightful talk about how rape novels in American literature have evolved to the present times and represent trends in American rape culture. In the context of #MeToo , her book is a valuable resource and a must read!

The edited book collection on #MeToo that I worked on will be published this October 2021. Thank you to the editors, Heather Hewett and Mary Holland as well as @robinfield for this amazing opportunity! https://t.co/vhzkzDeFfb https://t.co/GsZpyT2Ghl
The chapter here is published from one of the sections from my dissertation! Here are the table of contents from the edited collection! #MeToo #endrapeculture #book https://t.co/VJX5NV2sRJ
@filmstarstudies I wonder if it’s a result of the impact from Harvey Weinstein scandal and the impact of the #metoo.
